• Monument Grills is committed to providing all users with a positive and convenient online experience. We recognize the importance of accessibility and are taking a series of measures to continuously improve and optimize our website, ensuring that more people can access information and complete purchases smoothly and equitably.

  • To this end, we are actively investing the necessary resources to enhance the structure, functionality, and content presentation of our website, improving compatibility with various assistive tools and technologies. We also continuously monitor and evaluate the accessibility performance of our website and make ongoing improvements based on feedback.

  • If you have any questions or feedback regarding Monument Grills’ accessibility support, please contact us.
    Email: customerservice@monumentgrills.com
    Phone: +1-800-530-9133
